question: In which of the following countries was the 1979 Asian Wrestling Championships organized by the Asian Associated Wrestling Committee (AAWC) for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jalandhar, India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asian Wrestling Championships **is the Wrestling Asian Championship organized by the Asian Associated Wrestling Committee (AAWC).
 
• The **men's event began in 1979** and The** women's event was first offered in 1996,** and it has been held every time.
 
• In **1979 **Jalandhar, India hosted the first Asian Wrestling Championships.
 
• Iran with **317 medals** leads the total and **159 Gold medals** are the topper as of the date got from the **2014 Championship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Asian Wrestling Championships 2022:**

 
 
• The 30-member Indian contingent shared at the **35th Edition of Asian Wrestling Crowns 2022 held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.**
 
• Indian wrestlers secured an aggregate of** 17 orders, which includes( 1- Gold, 5- tableware, and 11- Citation orders).**
 
• Gold Medalist **Ravi Kumar Dahiyais the only Gold semifinalist representing India, in the men’s 57 kg freestyle orde**r, beating Kazakhstan’s Rakhat Kalzhan on specialized superiority.
